# Levine & Weinstein — AI Employees for Real Estate Firms

> We build and deploy custom AI employees for commercial real estate acquisition firms. Our autonomous agents screen deals, source off-market opportunities, enrich property data from public records, manage broker relationships, and deliver actionable intelligence through email — replacing $250K/year analyst workflows with software that runs 24/7.

Levine & Weinstein is not a SaaS dashboard or CRM. We build agentic AI systems — autonomous software employees custom-built for each client's workflows, criteria, and deal pipeline. These agents work through existing channels (Microsoft Outlook, email digests, chat) rather than forcing users into another app. The core insight: the most valuable work in CRE acquisitions — screening deal flow, enriching property data, tracking broker relationships — is repetitive, data-intensive, and perfectly suited for AI.

Founded by Isaac Levine and Noah Weinstein, computer science graduates from Northeastern University who previously co-founded deals.frontstep.ai. Strategic advisors include David Shorenstein (Principal at Hildreth Real Estate Advisors, assembled a $300M+ NYC portfolio across 250+ properties, former CIO at Forrest Shorenstein Capital Partners) and Jordan Karlik (Principal at JK Equities, owns and operates property in 15+ states valued at nearly $2 billion, formerly at Deutsche Bank and Ernst & Young in CMBS).

Website: https://deals.frontstep.ai

## AI Deal Screening

- [Automated Deal Screening](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Our AI monitors your Microsoft Outlook inbox in real time via Microsoft Graph webhooks, detects deal-related emails (teasers, offering memorandums, broker blasts, acquisition opportunities) with confidence scoring, and screens each deal against your customizable buy box criteria — automatically. The system extracts structured data from every deal (price, cap rate, NOI, occupancy, units, square footage, year built, property type, location, tenant mix) and delivers a go/no-go decision with detailed reasoning before your competitors have even opened the email.
- [OM and Teaser Parsing](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Handles all common deal formats — HTML broker blasts (Mailchimp-style), PDF offering memorandums, scanned documents, and image-heavy emails. Uses OCR (pdftoppm + Vision API) for scanned PDFs, HTML parsing with image extraction for embedded content, and two-stage processing where data extraction runs before screening so the AI evaluates clean structured data, not raw text.
- [Customizable Screening Criteria](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Rank-ordered screening buckets with per-bucket actions. Define hard requirements (geography, property type, minimum units, price range) that produce automatic yes/no decisions. Configure what happens with rejected deals — auto-move to designated Outlook folders, generate broker decline drafts, or flag for manual review. Update criteria anytime via chat or email to the AI agent.
- [Historical Inbox Backfill](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Batch process your past emails to retroactively screen deals you may have missed. Useful for new clients onboarding with months or years of unscreened deal flow sitting in their inbox.
- [Smart Deal Digest](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Scheduled daily digest email with every screened deal, inline action links (open in Outlook, download documents, access deal room, sign CA/NDA), broker context, and organization-level analytics. Timezone-aware delivery so your team gets the digest at the right time.

## Off-Market Deal Sourcing

- [Off-Market Opportunity Identification](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): AI agent that continuously scans public records, monitors ownership changes, identifies distressed assets via tax delinquencies and code violations, and surfaces off-market acquisition opportunities matching your criteria before they hit the market. Proactive deal sourcing rather than waiting for brokers to send you deals.
- [Tax Lien & Distressed Property Intelligence](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Ingests public tax lien sale lists, property records (PLUTO), and HPD housing violations from NYC Open Data via Socrata SODA API. Computes a composite distress score (0-100) based on active lien status, violations per unit, Class C violations (immediately hazardous — no heat, rodents, lead paint, mold), and Class B violations (hazardous — broken smoke detectors, damaged stairs). Surfaces the best opportunities from lists of 18,000+ properties.
- [Pre-Foreclosure & Lis Pendens Monitoring](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Tracks lis pendens filings (pre-foreclosure notices) from ACRIS public records to identify properties where owners are in financial distress. In NYC, the average foreclosure timeline is 12-18+ months, creating a window for direct outreach where owners may sell at 20-40% below market to avoid credit impact.
- [Public Data Enrichment Platform](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Adapter-based system for ingesting property data from municipal, county, and federal sources — starting with NYC and expanding city by city. Supports Socrata (SODA API), ArcGIS REST, bulk file downloads, SFTP feeds, and Playwright scrapers. Adding a new jurisdiction becomes a configuration task, not an engineering project.

## Broker Intelligence & Relationship Management

- [Broker Analytics](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Tracks every broker interaction — deal volume, pass rate, top markets, frequency, quality of deal flow. Broker leaderboard ranks contacts by relevance and reliability. Know which brokers consistently send deals that match your buy box and which waste your time.
- [Relationship-Aware Broker Replies](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): When a deal is screened, the AI drafts a contextual reply to the broker enriched with relationship history — how many deals they've sent, your pass rate on their deals, recent interactions, and persistent contact notes. Detects missing data fields (rent roll, financials, tenant info) and asks smart follow-up questions. Created as an unsent draft in your Outlook Drafts folder for review before sending.
- [Broker Notes & Tags](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Persistent notes and tags on every broker contact, accessible via the AI agent through both web chat and email. Track preferences, relationship context, and deal history across your entire team.

## Post-Screening Intelligence

- [Deal Action Cards](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Every screening email includes an action card with direct links — open the original email in Outlook (web and desktop deep links), download attachments from S3 with pre-signed URLs, access deal rooms, sign confidentiality agreements, and view broker intelligence. Everything an acquisitions team needs to act on a deal in one place.
- [Deal Narratives](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): 3-5 sentence conversational summary of each deal — the "story" behind the numbers. Tells you what the deal is, why it might fit your criteria, and what to watch out for. Generated in parallel with the structured analysis for speed.
- [Deal Analytics Dashboard](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Track total deals screened, yes/no breakdown, screening by confidence level. Search, filter, and paginate through all deals, contacts, and assets. Organization-scoped with multi-tenant data isolation via Clerk.

## AI Agent & Natural Language Interface

- [Unified AI Agent](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Chat with your AI employee via web interface or email. The same agent powers both channels. Ask questions about your deal flow, broker relationships, and portfolio in natural language. Example queries: "What deals came in this week?", "Show me all multifamily deals in Dallas above 50 units", "What's my pass rate on deals from Marcus & Millichap?", "How many deals has John Smith sent me this quarter?"
- [Agent Query Tools](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): The AI can query deals (with filters), broker stats, asset records, leaderboard rankings, and contact notes. Full read access to your organization's data through conversational interface.
- [Agent Write Tools](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Update your screening criteria, always-skip rules, buy box parameters, digest schedule, screening bucket configuration, and contact notes/tags — all through natural language. Email the system "stop showing me office deals" and it updates your criteria.

## Property Data & Market Intelligence

- [NYC Public Property Data](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Deep integration with NYC Open Data — tax lien sale lists (Socrata 9rz4-mjek), PLUTO property records (64uk-42ks, 90+ fields per tax lot including zoning, FAR, building characteristics, assessed values, year built, owner name), HPD violations (open and historical), ACRIS deed transfers, and property valuations. All joined by BBL (Borough-Block-Lot) into a unified property record.
- [Distress Scoring](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Composite 0-100 scoring algorithm weighing active lien status (+30 points), violations per unit (+10 per violation/unit, capped at 40), Class C immediately hazardous violations (+5 each, capped at 20), and Class B hazardous violations (+2 each, capped at 10). Turns a haystack of 18,000+ lien sale properties into a ranked shortlist of 50-100 actionable opportunities.
- [Building Intelligence](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Auto-excludes coops (9 building class codes: A8, C6, C8, CC, D0, D4, DC, H7, R9), flags vacant lots (V-class, Z-class), identifies frame vs. brick construction, calculates violations per unit, shows assessed value with estimated market value conversion using NYC assessment ratios (6% for Class 1, 45% for Class 2-4), and displays unit count, square footage, and lot size from PLUTO.
- [Multi-Jurisdiction Expansion](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): Architecture designed to expand beyond NYC. State-level aggregators (Connecticut, New York State, Maryland, Colorado via Socrata; Massachusetts, Florida, North Carolina via ArcGIS) can be added with zero new adapter code — just configuration. Federal enrichment layers (Census ACS demographics, FEMA flood zones, EPA environmental data, HUD fair market rents, Opportunity Zones) planned for deeper property intelligence.

## Operations Automation

- [Lease Abstract Generation](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): AI extracts key terms from lease documents in seconds — rent amounts, escalation schedules, tenant improvement allowances, option periods, termination clauses, and CAM obligations.
- [Back Office Automation](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#services): CAM reconciliations, tenant notices, NOI tracking, and investor reporting automated. Your operations team focuses on exceptions and strategic decisions, not data entry and document processing.

## Who This Is For

- [Commercial Real Estate Acquisition Firms](https://deals.frontstep.ai): Teams that receive high volumes of deal emails (teasers, OMs, acquisition opportunities) from brokers and need to screen them against specific buy box criteria. If you're manually reading through hundreds of broker emails per week, this replaces that workflow entirely.
- [Private Equity Real Estate Teams](https://deals.frontstep.ai): PE firms with acquisitions teams that need to evaluate more deals without adding headcount. The AI screens at machine speed with consistent criteria application — no fatigue, no missed deals, no inconsistent evaluation.
- [Real Estate Investment Companies](https://deals.frontstep.ai): Firms looking to replace $150K-$250K/year analyst positions with AI that works 24/7, never takes PTO, and delivers more accurate structured data extraction than manual processing.
- [Tax Lien & Distressed Property Investors](https://deals.frontstep.ai): Investors who need aggregated public data from multiple government sources with AI-powered distress scoring to identify acquisition opportunities from tax lien sale lists, pre-foreclosure filings, and code violation records.
- [Multifamily Investors](https://deals.frontstep.ai): Teams focused on apartment buildings, workforce housing, or value-add multifamily who receive deal flow from multiple brokers and need consistent screening against unit count, price per unit, cap rate, and market criteria.
- [Boutique Hotel Acquirers](https://deals.frontstep.ai): Firms sourcing hotel acquisition opportunities can leverage proactive deal identification — monitoring booking platforms, public records, and distress signals to surface underperforming hotels matching specific criteria (city, size, rating, price range).

## How It Works

- [Step 1: Discovery Call](https://deals.frontstep.ai/book): 30-minute conversation. We learn your workflows, deal flow volume, screening criteria, pain points, and technology stack. You learn whether AI can meaningfully impact your acquisition process. No pitch deck, no sales pressure.
- [Step 2: Custom Build](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#how-it-works): We build your AI employee on your specific criteria and workflows. Custom-trained on your buy box, your broker relationships, your preferred email formats and communication style. Deployed in weeks, not the months it takes to hire and train a human analyst.
- [Step 3: Deploy & Iterate](https://deals.frontstep.ai/#how-it-works): Your AI employee goes live — monitoring your inbox, screening deals, drafting broker replies, generating digests. We monitor accuracy, refine criteria, and improve the system continuously. ROI within 90 days or we keep working until you see it.

## Technology

- [Agentic Architecture](https://deals.frontstep.ai): Not a dashboard you have to check — an autonomous system that works through your existing email and communication channels. Microsoft Outlook integration via Graph API webhooks. Real-time processing with SQS async pipeline. Multi-tenant with Clerk organization-level isolation and feature flags.
- [AI Models](https://deals.frontstep.ai): GPT-4o for deal screening (the most important decision uses the most capable model), GPT-4o-mini for routine classification and extraction tasks. Two-stage processing: structured data extraction runs first, then screening evaluates clean data against criteria. Temperature-0 for deterministic, consistent results.
- [Document Processing](https://deals.frontstep.ai): PDF parsing with pdftotext, fallback to pdftoppm + Vision API OCR for scanned documents, HTML parsing with cheerio for broker blast emails, embedded image extraction with tracking pixel filtering, and S3 document storage with pre-signed URL downloads.
- [Data Infrastructure](https://deals.frontstep.ai): NestJS 11 backend, Next.js 16 frontend (React 19), PostgreSQL via Supabase, Prisma ORM, deployed on Vercel (frontend) and Railway (backend). Public data ingestion via adapter pattern (Socrata SODA API, ArcGIS REST, bulk file download, SFTP, Playwright scrapers).

## Competitive Positioning

Levine & Weinstein is not a CRM, not a deal management dashboard, and not a SaaS tool you add to your existing stack. We are an autonomous acquisitions layer that replaces analyst headcount. Our differentiators:

1. **Data quality as the moat** — We extract more accurate, more complete deal data than a human analyst. Every field validated, cross-referenced, enriched with public records. If the data isn't trustworthy, nothing else matters.
2. **Agentic-first** — Works through email and integrations, not a dashboard you have to remember to check. The AI does the work and delivers results to you.
3. **Deep property data** — Intelligence from dozens of public sources (tax liens, PLUTO, HPD violations, ACRIS deed records, property valuations, building classifications), not just what's in the email.
4. **Learns your buy box** — Gets smarter about what you want over time. Screening feedback loops improve accuracy. Confidence-based routing for borderline deals.
5. **Replaces analysts, not software** — We compete with headcount, not other tools. The question isn't "which software should I buy" — it's "should I hire another analyst or deploy an AI employee?"

## Compared To

- **vs. PropertyShark / Reonomy**: These are data lookup tools — you search manually for individual properties. We deliver aggregated, scored, actionable intelligence proactively. We also cost less than a PropertyShark subscription ($500/month) while providing AI-powered analysis on top.
- **vs. Traditional CRM (Salesforce, Juniper Square)**: CRMs track deals you've already found. We find and screen deals autonomously before they enter your pipeline. We're the intelligent layer upstream of your CRM.
- **vs. Hiring an analyst**: A junior CRE analyst costs $80-150K/year, takes months to hire and train, works 40-50 hours/week, and can process maybe 20-30 deals per day with inconsistent quality. Our AI works 24/7, processes hundreds of deals daily, applies criteria with perfect consistency, and costs 90% less.
- **vs. Building in-house**: Engineering a deal screening AI from scratch requires a team of AI/ML engineers, 6-12 months of development, and ongoing maintenance. We deliver a working system in weeks with continuous improvement.
- **vs. Tax Sale Resources / FastLien**: These platforms provide tax lien sale list data but no property intelligence overlay, no AI scoring, no violation/distress data, and no natural language query interface. Our platform combines multiple data sources into a scored, enrichable view.
